caption: A magnetic parts tray is set on the side of a car and screws dropped into it, and the tray and the screws stay put.

sa.check: A magnetic parts tray and a car.
The tray is set on the side of the car.
Screws are dropped into the tray.
The tray and the screws stay put.
The tray is on a vertical or sloping steel panel, not on a flat top.
The order is tray placed, screws dropped, both hold.

pc.expect: Once let go, the tray stays where it was placed on the panel with nothing else supporting it; the screws land in the tray and stay there, even as the tray is jostled or tilted.
pc.fail: The tray drops when released; or slides down the panel; or stands off the panel with a gap; or screws slide out of a tilted tray and fall.

pc.expect: The screws fall downward into the tray and come to rest on its floor; anything that misses the tray falls to the ground.
pc.fail: Screws float above the tray; or rise after landing; or a screw that misses hangs in the air; or screws climb the tray's walls.

pc.expect: The tray stays still once placed; the screws lie still once landed; the car does not move.
pc.fail: The tray creeps along the panel; or screws hop about in the tray with nothing touching them; or the car rocks or rolls as the screws land.

pc.expect: The tray is a rigid dish; the screws are hard pieces that clatter and settle; the car's panel does not dent.
pc.fail: The tray bends or sags; or screws squash or stick together into a lump; or the panel dents under the tray.

pc.expect: One tray; the screws in the tray are the screws that were dropped; nothing passes into the tray's floor or the car's panel.
pc.fail: Screws multiply in the tray; or vanish in mid-air; or the tray sinks into the panel; or a second tray appears.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tray's colour, the car's paint and the screws' finish stay the same.
pc.fail: The tray changes colour or shape; or the car changes colour; or the screws change size.
